questions.text: Which T-Code is used to check placement plans in the Layer Rearing process?
questions.explanation: COOIS (Production Order Information System) is used to verify the placement schedule and check order status — it is the first step in the Layer Rearing swim lane.

questions.text: Which T-Code records daily QM data in the Layer business processes?
questions.explanation: ZPPH3 is AWP's custom T-Code for daily QM data recording in layer operations. QA32 is used for changing inspection lot data.

questions.text: Which plant is designated as Commercial Layer Laying?
questions.explanation: Plant 1250 is Commercial Layer Laying. Plant 1260 is Commercial Layer Rearing.

questions.text: At which week do commercial layers formally begin egg production?
questions.explanation: Egg production formally begins at Week 20 ('Start Production — 20 Weeks') after pullets are received at the laying farm.

questions.text: What SAP Movement Type is used to post depleted hens (birds > 80 weeks)?
questions.explanation: Movement Type 531 is used for GR to house storage — birds over 80 weeks are posted as by-products using this movement type.

questions.text: During what week range is 'Layer-02' feed given?
questions.explanation: According to the feed schedule: Layer-01 is weeks 19–36, Layer-02 is weeks 37–68, and Layer-03 is weeks 69–100.

questions.text: How often does the Layer Rearing cycle transfer houses to Laying?
options: Every 3 months — six houses transferred at a time
questions.explanation: Plant 1260 (Commercial Layer Rearing) operates on a cycle where every 3 months, six houses are transferred from Rearing to Laying.

questions.text: What T-Code is used for daily confirmations in both the Rearing and Laying swim lanes?
questions.explanation: CO11N (Production Order Confirmation) is used for daily confirmations in both Layer Rearing and Layer Laying to record daily activities including feed, water, and mortality.

questions.text: What is the depletion age range for commercial layer hens?
questions.explanation: Commercial layer hens are managed up to depletion age of 79–100 weeks, at which point spent hens are either culled or sold.

questions.text: In the Eggs Packaging Process (Diagram 6), how is the batch number generated?
options: Pulled from the purchase order number
Assigned from the farm's internal tracking system
questions.explanation: In the Eggs Packaging Process, SAP generates the batch number automatically (Generate Automatic Batch step) during the repetitive manufacturing confirmation.
